name: Muse P300
description: For the 4-channel Muse (TP9 AF7 AF8 TP10, 256 Hz, dry electrodes referenced to Fpz). A 60 Hz notch in front of the default 0.5-20 Hz band-pass, because dry Muse contacts pick up much more mains hum than gelled electrodes. Artifact threshold 150 uV (forehead channels AF7/AF8 never reject an epoch, so blinks don't throw P300 epochs away). The Muse p3000 function (models/library/p3000_function_muse.npz) is built for this chain. Outside the Americas use 50 Hz.
